record_status: historical reconstruction, not a new live run

request.intent: Show that AOTN can run unattended and reach Telegram.

example.input: A scheduled run with a checked_at timestamp.
example.expected_result: AOTN alive with that timestamp appears in Telegram.

inputs: checked_at: string supplied by the wrapper
constraints: Use the separate live checkout and cron data root.
No model call; escape outside text and cap stdout.
success: Unhandled failure alerts; skipped output sends nothing.
unknowns: Historical days per step and review-round count were not captured.

feasibility.official_api: No new external API: use installed Hermes no-agent cron and its existing Telegram destination.
feasibility.sign_in: Existing owner-configured Telegram transport; wrapper holds no bot token.
feasibility.cost: No model call; no price assertion about hosting or transport.
feasibility.reliability: Check script-path rules, absolute interpreter, deadline, escaping and output cap; verify on phone.
feasibility.terms_of_service: No new API integration; separate terms review was not recorded. Recheck provider terms if scope changes.
feasibility.reason: The installed no-agent script route was checked and the owner confirmed Telegram delivery.
alternatives: Use manual headless execution for local-only checks.

coverage.basis: Reconstructed at original delivery, before its new nodes landed; setup/transport and Start/End excluded.

measurements.note: Days for steps 0 through 11 and review rounds unknown; empty visits means not recorded, not zero.

acceptance_checks: Spec passes build --check in a temporary data root.
Timestamp input reaches the heartbeat text.

Unhandled failure reaches the transport alert path.
Live activation requires owner approval; phone confirmation is a separate check.
